title: "Isaiah"
---

# Isaiah

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Isaiah proclaims God's holiness, judgment, and salvation while pointing repeatedly to the coming Messiah. The book teaches that hope is found in trusting the Holy One of Israel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 1:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Come now, let us reason together</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Isaiah's most famous invitations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls Judah to repentance despite widespread rebellion. The key verse reveals God's willingness to forgive and restore those who turn to Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 2:4</div>

<div class="identifier">They shall beat their swords into plowshares</div>

### Why This Verse

Iconic peace prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter looks forward to the future reign of the Lord. The key verse envisions all nations coming to God's mountain for instruction and peace.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 3:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Say ye to the righteous, it shall be well</div>

### Why This Verse

Encouragement amid judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment upon Judah's leaders and society. The key verse highlights the consequences of abandoning God's ways.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 4:2</div>

<div class="identifier">The Branch of the LORD shall be beautiful</div>

### Why This Verse

Early messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises future cleansing and restoration. The key verse points to the Branch of the Lord and God's redeeming work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 5:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Woe unto them that call evil good</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted moral warning

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the song of the vineyard. The key verse reveals God's disappointment with His people's failure to produce righteousness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 6:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Here am I; send me</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the Bible's most famous calls to service

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Isaiah's vision and calling. The key verse expresses Isaiah's willingness to serve after encountering God's holiness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 7:14</div>

<div class="identifier">A virgin shall conceive</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic prophecy quoted in Matthew

### Chapter Insight

This chapter offers King Ahaz a sign of God's faithfulness. The key verse contains the prophecy of Immanuel, pointing to God's presence with His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 8:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not their fear</div>

### Why This Verse

Trust God rather than men

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns of coming judgment while encouraging trust in God. The key verse emphasizes revering the Lord rather than fearing people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 9:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Unto us a child is born</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the greatest messianic prophecies

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises hope through the coming Messiah. The key verse describes the child who will reign with justice and peace.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 10:27</div>

<div class="identifier">His yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited deliverance verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment on Assyria despite its role in God's purposes. The key verse highlights God's sovereignty over nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 11:6</div>

<div class="identifier">The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous kingdom peace imagery

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells the reign of the Messiah. The key verse presents the Spirit-filled descendant of Jesse who will rule righteously.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 12:2</div>

<div class="identifier">God is my salvation</div>

### Why This Verse

Song of trust

### Chapter Insight

This chapter is a song of praise for God's salvation. The key verse celebrates trust in God without fear.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 13:11</div>

<div class="identifier">I will punish the world for its evil</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prophesies Babylon's downfall. The key verse demonstrates God's authority over kingdoms and history.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 14:12</div>

<div class="identifier">How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most discussed prophetic verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues judgment against Babylon and prideful rulers. The key verse warns against self-exaltation before God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 15:5</div>

<div class="identifier">My heart shall cry out for Moab</div>

### Why This Verse

Compassion in judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter laments the coming judgment upon Moab. The key verse reflects sorrow over the consequences of national rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 16:5</div>

<div class="identifier">A throne shall be established in mercy</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic kingdom theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the prophecy against Moab. The key verse points to mercy and righteous rule as humanity's true hope.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 17:7</div>

<div class="identifier">At that day shall a man look to his Maker</div>

### Why This Verse

Turning back to God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prophesies judgment on Damascus and Israel. The key verse calls people to remember their Creator rather than trust earthly securities.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 18:7</div>

<div class="identifier">A present shall be brought unto the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Nations acknowledging God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses distant nations and God's sovereign purposes. The key verse emphasizes waiting upon God's timing.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 19:25</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed be Egypt My people</div>

### Why This Verse

Remarkable inclusion of the nations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells judgment and eventual restoration for Egypt. The key verse reveals God's desire to bring even foreign nations into His blessing.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 20:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Isaiah walked naked and barefoot</div>

### Why This Verse

Pr

### Chapter Insight

This chapter uses Isaiah's actions as a sign against misplaced trust in alliances. The key verse warns against relying on human powers instead of God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 21:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Watchman, what of the night?</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous prophetic question

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment on Babylon and other nations. The key verse captures the watchman's urgent message concerning coming events.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 22:22</div>

<div class="identifier">The key of the house of David</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Revelation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses Jerusalem's false confidence. The key verse points to God's authority and ultimately foreshadows the Messianic King who holds the key of David.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 23:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Her merchandise shall be holiness to the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Tyre ultimately redeemed

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prophesies judgment against Tyre. The key verse highlights the temporary nature of earthly wealth and commercial power.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 24:5</div>

<div class="identifier">The earth is defiled under its inhabitants</div>

### Why This Verse

Universal judgment theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes worldwide judgment. The key verse reveals God's sovereignty over all the earth and its inhabitants.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 25:8</div>

<div class="identifier">He will swallow up death in victory</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in 1 Corinthians 15

### Chapter Insight

This chapter offers praise for God's future victory and salvation. The key verse celebrates God's ultimate defeat of death and suffering.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 26:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Isaiah's most beloved promises

### Chapter Insight

This chapter is a song of trust and hope. The key verse emphasizes perfect peace for those whose minds are fixed on God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 27:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Israel shall blossom and bud</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises God's future restoration of Israel. The key verse depicts God's victory over evil and His care for His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 28:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold, I lay in Zion a cornerstone</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against pride and false security. The key verse introduces the cornerstone that provides a sure foundation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 29:13</div>

<div class="identifier">This people draw near with their mouth</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted by Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses Jerusalem's spiritual blindness. The key verse warns against outward religion without heartfelt devotion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 30:21</div>

<div class="identifier">This is the way, walk ye in it</div>

### Why This Verse

Guidance verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter rebukes reliance upon foreign alliances. The key verse reveals that strength is found in repentance and trust.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 31:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help</div>

### Why This Verse

Trust in God, not human strength

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the warning against trusting Egypt. The key verse emphasizes dependence upon God rather than military power.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 32:17</div>

<div class="identifier">The work of righteousness shall be peace</div>

### Why This Verse

Kingdom blessing

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells a righteous king and restored kingdom. The key verse points to the transforming work of God's Spirit.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 33:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts judgment with future glory. The key verse celebrates God as Judge, Lawgiver, and King.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 34:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Seek ye out of the book of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Appeal to God's word

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment upon the nations. The key verse highlights God's justice against persistent rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 35

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 35:10</div>

<div class="identifier">The redeemed of the LORD shall return</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration and joy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises restoration and joy for God's redeemed people. The key verse describes the highway of holiness leading to Zion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 36

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 36:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Thus saith the great king</div>

### Why This Verse

Rabshakeh's challenge

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Assyria's challenge to Judah. The key verse exposes the futility of trusting human power over God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 37

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 37:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Hezekiah spread it before the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Model of prayer in crisis

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Hezekiah's prayer and God's deliverance. The key verse demonstrates God's power to save those who trust Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 38

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 38:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou hast cast all my sins behind Thy back</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah's testimony

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Hezekiah's illness and healing. The key verse highlights God's mercy and responsiveness to prayer.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 39

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 39:6</div>

<div class="identifier">The days come that all shall be carried to Babylon</div>

### Why This Verse

Babylonian exile foretold

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals Hezekiah's pride before Babylonian envoys. The key verse foreshadows Judah's future exile.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 40

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 40:31</div>

<div class="identifier">They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted OT verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Isaiah's message of comfort and hope. The key verse proclaims renewed strength for those who wait upon the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 41

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 41:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear thou not; for I am with thee</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Scripture's greatest comfort verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reassures Israel of God's presence and help. The key verse emphasizes God's sustaining power for His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 42

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 42:3</div>

<div class="identifier">A bruised reed shall He not break</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic prophecy quoted in Matthew

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the Servant of the Lord. The key verse points to the Messiah who brings justice to the nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 43

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 43:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not, for I have redeemed thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Redemption and belonging

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates God's redemption and covenant love. The key verse emphasizes God's presence through every trial.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 44

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 44:22</div>

<div class="identifier">I have blotted out thy transgressions</div>

### Why This Verse

Powerful forgiveness imagery

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the living God with idols. The key verse declares God's uniqueness as the first and the last.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 45

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 45:22</div>

<div class="identifier">Look unto Me, and be ye saved</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Isaiah's greatest invitations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals God's sovereignty through Cyrus and His plan for Israel. The key verse declares that the Lord alone is God and there is no other.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 46

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 46:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Even to your old age I am He</div>

### Why This Verse

Promise of lifelong care

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts God with powerless idols. The key verse emphasizes God's ability to carry and sustain His people throughout life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 47

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 47:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Thy wisdom and thy knowledge have perverted thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Warning against pride

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces judgment upon Babylon. The key verse reveals the downfall of pride and self-sufficiency.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 48

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 48:17</div>

<div class="identifier">I am the LORD thy God who teaches thee to profit</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine guidance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter rebukes Israel's stubbornness while affirming God's faithfulness. The key verse highlights God's refining work through adversity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 49

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 49:16</div>

<div class="identifier">I have graven thee upon the palms of My hands</div>

### Why This Verse

Powerful image of God's remembrance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the Servant of the Lord as a light to the nations. The key verse expands God's salvation beyond Israel to all peoples.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 50

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 50:7</div>

<div class="identifier">I have set my face like a flint</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic determination

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes the Servant's obedience amid suffering. The key verse demonstrates steadfast trust in God despite opposition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 51

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 51:11</div>

<div class="identifier">The redeemed of the LORD shall return</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls God's people to remember His faithfulness. The key verse encourages confidence in God's everlasting salvation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 52

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 52:7</div>

<div class="identifier">How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Romans 10

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces redemption and introduces the suffering Servant. The key verse proclaims the beauty of those who bring good news.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 53

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 53:5</div>

<div class="identifier">He was wounded for our transgressions</div>

### Why This Verse

Perhaps the most important messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the suffering and sacrifice of the Servant. The key verse reveals that the Servant bears the sins of others to bring healing and redemption.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 54

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 54:17</div>

<div class="identifier">No weapon formed against thee shall prosper</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted promises in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises restoration and covenant blessing. The key verse assures God's enduring love despite past affliction.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 55

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 55:8</div>

<div class="identifier">My thoughts are not your thoughts</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted statement of God's transcendence

### Chapter Insight

This chapter invites all people to receive God's grace freely. The key verse calls the thirsty to come and receive God's provision.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 56

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 56:7</div>

<div class="identifier">My house shall be called a house of prayer</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted by Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter extends God's welcome to foreigners and outcasts. The key verse reveals God's desire for His house to be a house of prayer for all nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 57

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 57:15</div>

<div class="identifier">I dwell with him that is of a contrite spirit</div>

### Why This Verse

God's nearness to the humble

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the fate of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse promises God's presence with the humble and repentant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 58

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 58:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Is not this the fast that I have chosen?</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational justice passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter defines true fasting and genuine righteousness. The key verse emphasizes practical compassion and justice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 59

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 59:1</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD's hand is not shortened</div>

### Why This Verse

God's ability to save

### Chapter Insight

This chapter explains how sin separates people from God. The key verse highlights God's power to save despite human failure.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 60

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 60:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Arise, shine; for thy light is come</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Isaiah's most famous calls

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells Zion's future glory. The key verse calls God's people to arise because His light has come.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 61

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 61:1</div>

<div class="identifier">The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me</div>

### Why This Verse

Read by Jesus in Luke 4

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents the mission of the Anointed One. The key verse proclaims good news, healing, liberty, and restoration.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 62

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 62:1</div>

<div class="identifier">For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace</div>

### Why This Verse

Commitment to restoration

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises Jerusalem's future vindication. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 63

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 63:9</div>

<div class="identifier">In all their affliction He was afflicted</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine compassion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reflects on God's past mercies and coming judgment. The key verse celebrates God's role as Redeemer.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 64

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 64:8</div>

<div class="identifier">We are the clay, and Thou our potter</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic dependence imagery

### Chapter Insight

This chapter is a prayer for God's intervention and mercy. The key verse acknowledges God's authority as Creator and Father.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 65

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 65:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Revelation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts judgment with future blessing. The key verse introduces the promise of a new heavens and a new earth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 66

<div class="key-verse">Isaiah 66:13</div>

<div class="identifier">As one whom his mother comforteth</div>

### Why This Verse

Tender image of God's comfort

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes Isaiah with themes of worship, judgment, and restoration. The key verse emphasizes humility and reverence before God.
:::
